newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe on TV Monday night ahead of book release.
newsitem.headline: Juppe on TV Monday night ahead of book release.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe, whose book "Entre Nous" (Between You and Me) is to be published on Tuesday, will be interviewed on French television chain TF1 on Monday at 1900 GMT, the broadcaster announced.
The book by Juppe, France's least popular prime minister in modern French history, seeks to explain his centre-right government's policies to French citizens.
